payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear description of the Random Kitchen Sink (RKS) approach, including its mapping of data vectors and its application in natural language processing tasks.

claims.text: The Random Kitchen Sink (RKS) approach maps data vectors to a space where linear separation is possible, providing an approximate kernel function via explicit mapping.
RKS has been shown to achieve high accuracy in classification tasks, with a maximum accuracy of 99.53% when using features from the Fasttext model.
The effectiveness of the RKS approach improves with higher mapping dimensions, leading to better evaluation scores.
